title: How Do Geckos Walk on Ceilings?
description:
No glue, no suction cups—millions of microscopic hairs create the grip.

Microscopic setae branch into nanoscale contacts that get close enough for van der Waals attractions to add up.

Geckos control attachment directionally by changing the angle of their toe hairs, allowing rapid release.

The system can adhere to many smooth materials without leaving sticky residue.
